heading: ITR Filing 2026: CBDT Upgrades Portal for Smoother Returns
tldr: The Income Tax Department has significantly upgraded its e-filing portal to manage high traffic during the ITR filing season.
The portal is now equipped to process up to 1 crore Income Tax Returns (ITRs) per day, ensuring greater efficiency.
These enhancements aim to provide a smoother and faster filing experience for all taxpayers, especially as the July 31 deadline approaches.
Taxpayers can expect improved stability, reduced downtime, and quicker processing of their tax filings.
The upgrades are a proactive measure to address past performance issues and enhance user satisfaction.
caption:
Ever struggled with the tax website crashing? Good news! The Income Tax Department has supercharged its portal to handle a massive 1 crore tax returns daily. This means filing your taxes should be much smoother and faster this year, especially as the July 31st deadline gets closer. No more frustrating delays! Read more about what this means for you.
